payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort distinct values by value, then greedy scan to find longest chain of non-overlapping intervals (first[i] > last[prev]) and answer = distinct count - chain length.
payload.rationale: The code maps values to their first/last occurrence indices, processes in ascending order, and greedily extends a chain when intervals are non-overlapping; resetting when overlap occurs, which computes the max number of values that can stay in place. This is a greedy choice based on sorted order, not DP or amortized analysis.
